verses.text: Ach in Diosal, tanhwej in wal, anhej t'ayach tzin kol in b'a.
Mamin Jehová, swal t'ayach to Wajal ach. Masanil wach'il ay t'ayin, a t'ayach skoti.
Te wach' yik heb' tzach k'anab'ajan t'a skal heb' a chonhab'. In gana tzin aj t'a skal heb'.
Ol te k'ib'cha'anh syahelal heb' sb'atkan t'a spatik junok komon Dios. Max wak'ochlaj in b'a wak'an schik'il nok' silab' yet' heb' t'a skomon Dios chi'. Max wal-laj in b'a t'a sdiosal heb' chi'.
Mamin Jehová, anhej t'ayach swik' masanil wach'il. Ha achton tzak' masanil tas snib'ej in k'o'ol. T'a yol a k'ab' ayek' in k 'inal.
Ha wal b'aj ix echtejkan in makb'en, yelxo te wach'. Manhxo jantakok swach'il tas ix ak'kan chi' t'ayin.
Mamin Jehová, swal wach' lolonel t'ayach yujto a ach tzak' in razón, tza k'ayb'an pax in pensar t'ak'walil.
Masanil tiempo na'an achnhej wu'uj. Yujto ayachnhej ek' wet'ok, yuj chi' malaj tas tzin ik'ani.
Yuj chi' ste tzalaj in k'o'ol tzin b'itani. Malaj tas tzin na'a, yujto tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol.
Manh ol in aktejkanlaj t'a skal heb' chamnak, manh ol a cha k'ab'at in niwanil tik, a in k'anab'ajum in tik t'ayach.
Tzak' wojtakejel sb'e'al k 'inal, tzak'an tzalajb'ok in k'o'ol ayik ayinek' het'ok. Aynhej tzalajk'olal t'a a tz'ey t'a masanil k 'inal.
